args.title: Fix aria-live and auto-dismiss behavior for error toasts
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the ToastProvider to use assertive aria-live for error toasts instead of polite to ensure they are announced promptly. Also, prevent error toasts from auto-dismissing after 5 seconds to give users enough time to see them.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is with the ToastProvider component in src/components/Toast.tsx, which uses a polite aria-live region for all toasts causing error toasts to be announced late. Additionally, all toasts are dismissed after 5 seconds automatically, which is too short for error toasts. Changing to assertive aria-live for error toasts and disabling their auto-dismiss addresses this.
